column7: POST /api/v1/auth/tokens authenticated by a restricted PAT (project, environment, permission or CIDR restriction) minted a new PAT with no restriction: a one-call escape from ADR-042's least-privilege restriction, since creation never runs Authorize. Fixed: CreateOwnPAT refuses when the request carries a PAT restriction (403). Found by PAT-GUARD-1 while inventorying ungated routes
